what_works: Artist-led agency portfolio with editorial pacing — hero is a single cinematic still with a tight one-line headline, then sections breathe at magazine-spread length. A body shop or pro painter with strong project photos gets a gallery that feels curated, not catalog.
what_does_not_translate: Custom loading states and mouse-driven nav effects need an engineer; the contractor build should keep the pacing and crops but render navigation as a plain anchor list.
type_observations: Editorial serif headline (Tiempos-esque) at display sizes paired with neutral grotesk body; high tracking on small caps eyebrows.
